projects.name: Mangaro
projects.tagline: Persian-first, self-hosted manga reader for the Iranian market
projects.description: Curated manga platform built end-to-end: native Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, heavily refactored TachiyomiSY fork) talking to a single self-hosted Django REST backend. Phone-OTP auth, Free/Plus subscriptions via Zarinpal, RTL-locked Persian UI, and a sanctioned deploy pipeline to production on Liara.
highlights: Production system end-to-end: mobile app, API, billing, media proxy, CI, deploy scripts
Large-scale fork surgery — replacing upstream Tachiyomi systems with custom auth, source, and onboarding flows
Offline-first: local SQLDelight database is authoritative, backend mirrors it

projects.name: Zaboon
projects.tagline: Gamified English-learning app for Persian speakers
projects.description: Game-like language learning app built with React Native (Expo) and TypeScript, backed by a custom Python API. Quiz progression, leaderboards, alphabet training, Lottie-animated loading flows, over-the-air updates, and full RTL handling.
highlights: Second mobile stack alongside native Kotlin — React Native + Expo with OTA updates
Persian-first UX: RTL layout, localized game flows
Custom Python backend (ZaboonAPI) for content and progress
